assets.style: Painterly cinematic illustration, mystical and dramatic, deep violet and indigo night with radiant gold light, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition with one clear subject in the center, no text, no letters, no watermark.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: 장터에서 나무를 팔다가, <#0.2#> 누군가 읽는 금강경 한 구절을 들어요.
voices.caption: 장터에서 나무를 팔다가, 누군가 읽는 금강경 한 구절을 들어요.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: 그 순간, <#0.3#> 그는 깨달음을 얻었다고 해요.
voices.caption: 그 순간, 그는 깨달음을 얻었다고 해요.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: 불교에서는 이걸, <#0.2#> 단번에 깨닫는다는 뜻의 돈오라고 해요.
voices.caption: 불교에서는 이걸, 단번에 깨닫는다는 뜻의 돈오라고 해요.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: 수많은 삶이 필요하다던 깨어남이, <#0.2#> 지금은 훨씬 빨라졌어요.
voices.caption: 수많은 삶이 필요하다던 깨어남이, 지금은 훨씬 빨라졌어요.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: 당신도, <#0.2#> 이번 삶에서 훌쩍 도약할 수 있어요.
voices.caption: 당신도, 이번 삶에서 훌쩍 도약할 수 있어요.

images: a humble young woodcutter in simple old clothes in a busy ancient Chinese market, a bundle of firewood on his back
an old monk reciting from an ancient sutra scroll in the market, golden characters of light floating in the air
the woodcutter frozen still as golden light bursts softly from his chest while the crowd blurs around him
a serene young monk meditating under a tree on a misty mountain at dawn

animate.motion: golden light gently radiates outward from the woodcutter's chest, the crowd blurs and slows, petals of light drift upward
